paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.66% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+3.22%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-8.01%). Brent crude changed +0.20% to 104.49. Gold changed +0.43% to 4,175.0. Bitcoin changed -2.38% to 80,942.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.19%, a relative move of -1.65%. Among the firms tracked, BP (+9.66%) and ConocoPhillips (+9.63%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal (FT World). Purchase of $41bn market-value burrito chain would rank as largest restaurant acquisition of all time Deals and capital markets: BlackRock pulls in $205bn to take assets to record high (FT Markets). World’s largest asset manager has become an increasingly powerful force in private capital after acquisitions of HPS and Global Infrastructure Partners Central banks and macro: India’s interest rate rise tests an economy of two speeds (FT World). Plus, meet the Tata kingmaker Central banks and macro: Will September inflation cement US interest rate policy for the rest of the year? (FT World). Market Questions is the FT’s guide to the week ahead Geopolitics and trade: India’s central bank tries to shore up rupee as it nears record lows (FT Markets). Rise in energy costs due to US-Israel war on Iran has put downward pressure on the currency of the world’s fastest-growing major economy
